testcase.name: Scenario: Dismiss an additional area in the temporary ribbon: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:390:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dismiss an additional area in the temporary ribbon ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active ✔ When the user clicks the 3D Model tab ✔ Then the temporary command area opens ✔ When the user opens the Modify additional-command area ✔ Then the additional area shows Move Bodies, Bend Part and Copy Object ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the additional area and the temporary command area close ✔ And the ribbon remains minimized to tabs ✔ When the user clicks the 3D Model tab again ✔ Then the temporary command area opens ✔ And the Modify additional-command area remains closed
